rules.validation: Include only currently operating stores; omit closed or paused locations.
rules.inventory: Describe stable product categories and useful examples; never promise that a specific SKU is in stock today.
rules.mapLink: Prefer the store's canonical Google Maps place URL; coordinates or address search are acceptable fallbacks when no reliable place URL is available.
